docs.title: What is Slope Surfing
docs.text: Slope Surfing is a tech where you jump before hitting a slope. After jumping, a 0.25 second state starts where the player won't connect to the floor. It keeps you in the air state and pushes you up the slope and allows you avoid ground friction while not changing the direction of your velocity. We can benifit from this in multiple ways. 1. We can extend the amount of time we fall to maximize speed when the proceeding terrain is followed by a slope 2.
